Text.Text: The expedition leader is dead, and the last of the crews walked out of the Depths with their records. You gave them that chance, and you left no one behind to do it. That is the whole of Last Stand of the Light. Sit with me. We can finish your instruction now.

You have courage, but your command of the Force is not yet where it must be. The Depths would take you, and the people I am trying to save would be left with one more body to step over. Keep training. Come back when the Force answers you without hesitation.

Keep your voice down. Raiders have taken the Sith Crypt Depths, an old Sith tomb under the Sharptooth caves on Mon Cala that was only just broken open, and they fell on the survey crews cataloguing it. I brought the first of the wounded out, but others are still trapped below, and the raiders' rear guard holds the way out. Put down six Crypt Raiders and bring me the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet they took from the tombs. It will tell me what they are after.

Then take this key. It opens the sealed door in the old tomb wall, the purple stonework on the north side of the first cavern inside the Sharptooth Jungle Caves on Mon Cala. Six Crypt Raiders, and the tablet. If you find survivors, point them toward the way out before you go deeper.

Last Stand of the Light is what the Jedi taught those who stayed behind so others could leave. You hold the line where retreat is hardest, and you measure victory by who walks out, not by who you strike down. An escape route kept open is worth more than any death, however brave.

Mon Cala. From the landing in Dac City, take the surface streets east into the Coral Isles, through the inner isles to the outer ones. Go north-east into the Sharptooth Jungle and on to its northern reaches, where a cave mouth on the north-east side leads into the Sharptooth Jungle Caves. In the first cavern, a sealed door is set into purple stone on the north side. That is the tomb. I stay because the wounded I brought out still need passage off Smuggler's Moon, and pilots who will not sell them to the raiders' buyers.

Relic thieves. They answer to whoever pays for Sith artifacts, not to Malak and not to any master. Most are hired muscle, Wookiee Crypt Raiders and Crypt Marauders who fight with staffs. Their captain is a Cathar, their hardest fighters are Wookiees too, and their leader has some training in the Force. They attacked the survey crews for refusing to hand over the tomb records.
Six Crypt Raiders and the trial tablet. The sealed door is on the north side of the first cavern in the Sharptooth Jungle Caves on Mon Cala. The people below are still waiting.
You have the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet. Let me see it.
These markings list the tombs they have already opened. They stripped what they could carry and moved their handlers deeper into the Depths. Rest. When you are ready, I will need you again.

The raiders are pulling deeper and taking the relics with them. Their Crypt Marauders carry the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard, a relic they use to draw on the Force without understanding it. Put down five Crypt Marauders and bring the shard back to me before they learn what it can really do.
Five Crypt Marauders, and the focus shard. They move through the Depths in small bands. Find them before they find the crews.

It was taken from a sealed relic chamber. In the wrong hands it lends strength to whoever holds it, and the raiders have been using it to break tomb seals. Without it, they are thieves with staffs and nothing more.
They keep no single camp. The Marauders roam the Depths in small bands, and one of them always carries the shard. Search the passages and it will turn up.
They fight in pairs and cover each other. Do not let them draw you away from your own way out. Break one, then the next, and never fight with your back to an open passage.
Five Crypt Marauders and the focus shard, somewhere in the Sith Crypt Depths. Every hour they hold it, another seal breaks.
You brought the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard. Hand it to me, carefully.
It has gone quiet in my hand. Good. Without it, the raiders will have to break the next seal the hard way, and that means their captain.

Their captain, a Cathar they call the Crypt Breach Captain, holds the trial altar on the west side of the Depths. He broke the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil off a sealed tomb and wears it like a trophy. Stand at that altar and he will come to you. Do not go alone. Bring at least two allies you trust, and bring me the sigil.
Then find your two. The altar is on the west side of the Sith Crypt Depths. When the captain falls, take the sigil, and see that all three of you come back.

A Cathar mercenary, the best fighter they have. They put him at the altar to hold off the survey crews, and it worked; three of them did not come back. He will not give ground, and he does not stop when he is hurt.
It was broken off a sealed tomb entrance. The markings will tell me which tomb they forced and what they took from it. The crews need that before they can seal the rest.

Because one fighter alone at that altar is easy to pin and easy to finish. Three can split his attention, cover each other, and carry out anyone who falls. That is the heart of this discipline: no one is left behind.
The captain still holds the altar on the west side of the Depths. Bring two allies, and bring back the sigil.
You brought the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil, and you came back on your own feet. Let me see it.
Here is the tomb they forced, and here are the ones they have not reached yet. With the captain gone, the crews can start sealing them again.

With their captain dead, the raiders' strongest have stepped up. Four Wookiees they call Crypt Reavers now guard the way to the last sealed vaults, and between them they carry the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token, an old keeper's mark that opens those vaults. Put down four Crypt Reavers and bring me the token.
Four Crypt Reavers and the token. They range through the Depths on their own. Take them one at a time, and do not let them gather.

Wookiees, bought by the expedition for their strength or held to it by debt. Whatever brought them here, they will tear apart anyone who stands between their leader and his relics. Do not hesitate with them. They will not hesitate with you.
The old keepers of these tombs carried it. It opens the deepest vaults. While the raiders hold it, nothing below is safe; once we have it, the crews can seal those vaults for good.
Never let more than one of them reach you at a time. Pick your ground, keep your allies close, and watch the passage behind you. A Wookiee in a narrow tunnel is a wall that hits back.
Four Crypt Reavers and the Keeper's Rite Token. They are still somewhere in the Sith Crypt Depths.
You brought the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token. Let me see it.
The token is safe, and the vaults will stay closed. Only their leader is left, and he knows it.

Their leader, the Crypt Expedition Leader, has pulled back into the Final Ritual Chamber, through the door at the north end of the Depths. He is a Cathar with some training in the Force, and he is gathering the last of the stolen relics to leave. Stop him before he does. Bring at least two allies. This is the last chamber.
Then go together, and come back together. The Final Ritual Chamber is through the north door of the Sith Crypt Depths. I will be here when you return.
The expedition leader himself, with the best of what they stole gathered around him. Break his hold there, and the surviving crews can finally walk out.

He draws on the stolen relics and on the darkness of that place. He will try to cut you off from one another and finish whoever stands alone. Stay close, cover each other, and keep a way out open behind you.

The crews finish their withdrawal, and I see the last of the wounded off Smuggler's Moon. The records you recovered will tell us what was stolen and who bought it. After that, we finish your instruction.
The Crypt Expedition Leader is in the Final Ritual Chamber, at the north end of the Depths. Take your allies.
The Crypt Expedition Leader is down. Tell me what happened.

The expedition leader is dead, and the last of the crews walked out of the Depths with their records. You gave them that chance, and you left no one behind to do it. That is the whole of Last Stand of the Light. Sit with me. We can finish your instruction now.

The Promenade on Smuggler's Moon lets me meet rescuers of every allegiance in one place, and the wounded can find ships here that ask no questions. I judge what you do for the crews, not whose colors you wear. The work itself is on Mon Cala, in the Sith Crypt Depths beneath the Sharptooth Jungle Caves. Take the key there, then bring your findings back to me here.
Go over the first assignment.
I'll go down and bring back the tablet.
What does this discipline teach?
Where do I go, and why are you staying here?
Who or what will I be fighting?
I need to prepare first.
Here is the recovered tablet.
Go over the next objective.
I will recover the focus shard.
Why does the shard matter?
Where do they keep it?
How do they fight?
I need more time.
Here is the focus shard.
Go over the captain again.
I'll bring two allies and take the sigil.
Who is the captain?
Why recover the broken sigil?
Why bring a group?
I will gather my companions first.
The captain is dead. Here is the sigil.
Go over the four Reavers again.
I'll stop the four Crypt Reavers.
Who are these Reavers?
What does the token do?
How should we approach them?
I need to rest first.
Here is the recovered token.
Go over the final objective.
We will go in together.
What is waiting in the last chamber?
What makes the leader dangerous?
What happens after this?
My companions need to prepare.
The final target is down. We made it out.
Why are we meeting here, and where is the trial?
Back to the assignment.
